coverage_exempt.reason: Coordinator reviewed the original reset loop: ESI is initialized to 0 at 0x49a727, preserved by the only callee 0x49ae60, incremented exactly once at 0x49a7df, and the backedge at 0x49a7ed is taken only while ESI < 15. Thus the tests at 0x49a7d0 and 0x49a7d5 cannot reach the two-byte failure assignment for any permitted returning invocation; the full body remains owned.
